description: Verify an Agent Trust Card (ATC) before interacting with an untrusted agent or skill. Checks the Ed25519 signature, expiry date, and revocation status. Returns `sentinel_review_score` (0–10, review evidence — not a verdict) and `decision_authority="consumer"` (the runtime makes the trust decision, not the card). Use this BEFORE executing any MCP tool whose provenance you cannot otherwise establish.

card_id.description: ATC card ID. Format: ATC-YYYY-NNNNNNN (e.g. ATC-2026-7777670).

name: marketnow_verify_trust
